resources.string: Ask a question or ask me to save a note…
Your agent runs on this phone. Connect your own model to get started. Notes are saved locally; every agent write needs your approval.
Leave blank to retain the key for the same endpoint

Messages and requested notes/documents go directly to your model endpoint. The API key is encrypted with Android Keystore. Background tasks use Android services and schedules; they can be delayed or stopped by the system. Writes require your approval. No desktop shell or computer-control tools are included.
Configure your model connection in Settings first.
Enter an HTTPS base URL without a query, username or fragment, a model ID, and an API key.

Title: %1$s

%2$s

Existing content is replaced only if its reviewed revision still matches.
Task stopped. Committed notes are retained.
The request did not finish. Check your network, model configuration or quota. Your conversation is retained.
Stop the current task before switching conversations or settings.
Local data could not be read or saved. Existing files have not been replaced.
This conversation has reached its limit. Start a new conversation; the current one is retained.
The previous task was interrupted. It will not be retried automatically.
This note changed after it was opened. Reopen it before saving.

Import a private copy of DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT, Markdown or CSV (up to 8 MiB). Ask the agent to read or edit it; approve each write. Export explicitly to save outside ClawMaster. Complex layout is not rendered.
Imported and generated documents appear here.
This document could not be processed. Check its format, size and permissions; the imported original is retained.

Schedules may run later under Android battery/network limits. Each run is limited to 8 minutes. Your model account may be charged. Writes pause for review; interrupted or failed runs are not automatically repeated. Repeating tasks require at least 15 minutes.
Describe the task and its expected result
No conversation is available yet, or another task is running.
Could not update the task. Check the schedule; review pending approvals before retrying.
Start a new run? Inspect the previous result first. It may already contain completed writes, and this run can incur model charges.
Task running. Tap to view, or Stop to cancel.
A write needs your review. Open ClawMaster.
A task has finished or stopped. Open ClawMaster to inspect the result.
Manage ClawMaster notifications in Android system settings.
